notes: Locked narration for the Priora vision film. `text` is the displayed text (captions, SCRIPT.md). `tts_text` holds the spoken form per engine when it differs; every spoken form keeps exactly one whitespace token per displayed token so word timings map back one to one. `gap_after` is designed silence after the line, `pre_gap` designed silence before it, both measured speech to speech. `guide_inner_pauses` are the pauses the local guide voice inserts between the sentences of a line (the ElevenLabs performance supplies its own).

2026-09-29: copy trimmed for a natural pace inside the 90 s edit (user direction: trim copy or adjust pauses rather than rushing the voice). L08 drops 'But'; L14 ends 'and keeps the record' (L15 carries 'as it happens'); L17 reads 'The risk owner decides: ... ask selected carriers to cover it.' Pauses tightened; rewind silence and the crossing hold protected.

2026-09-29 (second pass): measured articulation rates showed L14, L16 and L17 running over 6 syllables per second. L14 is split so the connection gets its own sentence and a 0.8 s pause; L16 becomes 'The sprinkler goes offline again. This time, Priora sees it at once.'; L17 simplified to 'change the work, knowingly retain the risk, or, in time, ask selected carriers to cover it.' Room added after 'offline' (1.2 s), 'nobody sees it' (1.0 s), the rewind (4.2 s of silence), the connection (0.8 s) and the crossing (1.4 s). Per-line pace slows the opening, key beats and close.

2026-09-29 (third pass): L05 'in mind', L06 'hot work begins, every safeguard in place' (the certificate is named in L14b and shown on screen), L08 drops 'Work continues' (the drawing shows it). Lead-in 0.8 s, end hold 2.0 s before the final fit.
2026-09-29 (fourth pass): L14a 'connects the work to the conditions that matter' (matches 'change the work' in L17); slower delivery on L01, L14a and L20.

2026-09-29 (cut 2): no fixed runtime (user direction: let the narration, comprehension and story set the length). Natural delivery: narrator speed 1.0 (no speed-up), a few key lines slower. Every line starts on the 92 BPM beat grid (pacing.grid): the designed gap is the minimum silence, placement waits for the next beat. L17 restored to 'ask selected carriers whether they will cover it' and split into L17a/b/c so each choice gets its own beat and room. The rewind gets two bars; the full chain holds before 'Priora'; the qualifier gets reading time in the end hold.
2026-09-29 (cut 2 build): more room at the crossing (L16 gap 2.8) and after the first two choices (L17a 1.3, L17b 1.2) so each composed choice holds before the next is spoken.

2026-09-30 (cut 3): the end section is rewritten for the ICP (whoever carries the risk): three scenarios beyond hot work (crane lift, gas detector bypass, confined space entry), 'Most work stays ordinary...', then 'For everyone who carries the risk, the gap closes.' The five-word chain is removed. The tagline replaces 'Infrastructure for activity-level physical risk' (pending the user's choice). Guide pronunciation of Priora moves from pree-AW-ruh to pree-OH-ruh (pending confirmation).

grid.note: Line starts snap up to the next half beat (30/92 s) on the 92 BPM grid. lead_in is one bar; the total snaps up to the next half beat.

Roof 03.note: Zero is said oh, British usage. Applied in tts_text of L06 and L13 for both engines.

Priora.note: See pronunciations.Priora for the per-engine mechanism.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every industrial site changes by the hour.
lines.delivery: Quiet, observational opening. Unhurried, no announcer lift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Contractors arrive. Equipment is isolated. Work moves.
lines.delivery: Three plain observations, even weight, the site coming alive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Insurance sets conditions under which risk is accepted.
lines.delivery: Matter of fact. Slight weight on conditions and accepted.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Good teams translate them into permits, briefings and checklists.
lines.delivery: Respectful of the teams. The list is competent, not tired.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But no one can hold a moving site in mind.
lines.delivery: The turn. Human and understanding, not critical.

tts_text.guide: But no one can hold a moving site in mind.
tts_text.elevenlabs: But no one can hold a moving site in mind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On Roof 03, hot work begins, every safeguard in place.

tts_text.guide: On Roof oh-three, hot work begins, every safeguard in place.
tts_text.elevenlabs: On Roof oh-three, hot work begins, every safeguard in place.

lines.delivery: Specific and calm. Everything is correct at this point.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a sprinkler zone goes offline.
lines.delivery: Understated. No drama in the voice; the silence after it does the work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing looks different. The conditions have changed, and nobody sees it.
lines.delivery: Controlled tension. Short beats, then the quiet realisation on nobody sees it.

tts_text.guide: Nothing looks different. The conditions have changed, and nobody sees it.
tts_text.elevenlabs: Nothing looks different. The conditions have changed, and nobody sees it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If something goes wrong, questions begin afterwards:
lines.delivery: Restrained. Leads straight into the questions.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What was happening? Which condition applied? Can you prove what was true?
lines.delivery: Forensic. Each question stands alone, slightly more pointed each time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Today, the gap is often discovered too late.
lines.delivery: Land the idea. Plain, final, no sigh.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What if the decision existed when the risk changed?
lines.delivery: After the rewind silence. Open, curious, forward looking.
lines.pre_gap_note: REWIND: two bars at 92 BPM (the reverse run, then the landing hold). Picture and sound reverse here.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: I'm welding on Roof 03 until six.

tts_text.guide: I'm welding on Roof oh-three until six.
tts_text.elevenlabs: I'm welding on Roof oh-three until six.

lines.delivery: A real worker speaking into a phone on site. Natural, close-mic, practical, not a slogan.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora connects the work to the conditions that matter.

tts_text.guide: Priora connects the work to the conditions that matter.
tts_text.elevenlabs: Pree-OR-uh connects the work to the conditions that matter.

lines.delivery: Clear and unhurried; this is the moment the connection becomes visible. Let it land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It checks the certificate and safeguards, and keeps the record.

tts_text.guide: It checks the certificate and safeguards, and keeps the record.
tts_text.elevenlabs: It checks the certificate and safeguards, and keeps the record.

lines.delivery: Plain, factual, confident.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Prevention before the work. Proof as it happens.
lines.delivery: Let each half stand. Confident through precision, not emphasis.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sprinkler goes offline again. This time, Priora sees it at once.

tts_text.guide: The sprinkler goes offline again. This time, Priora sees it at once.
tts_text.elevenlabs: The sprinkler goes offline again. This time, Pree-OR-uh sees it at once.

lines.delivery: Two beats: the event, then the contrast with Act I. 'This time' carries it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The risk owner decides: change the work,

tts_text.guide: The risk owner decides: change the work,
tts_text.elevenlabs: The risk owner decides: change the work,

lines.delivery: First choice. Measured; a small comma lift, not a full stop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: knowingly retain the risk,
lines.delivery: Second choice. Its own weight on knowingly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: or, in time, ask selected carriers whether they will cover it.

tts_text.guide: or, in time, ask selected carriers whether they will cover it.
tts_text.elevenlabs: or, in time, ask selected carriers whether they will cover it.

lines.delivery: Third choice. Honest and unhurried; carrier acceptance stays conditional.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every kind of work carries its own conditions.
lines.delivery: Opening the wider view. Plain and assured.

tts_text.guide: Every kind of work carries its own conditions.
tts_text.elevenlabs: Every kind of work carries its own conditions.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A crane lift, as the wind picks up.
lines.delivery: First vignette. Concrete, unhurried.

tts_text.guide: A crane lift, as the wind picks up.
tts_text.elevenlabs: A crane lift, as the wind picks up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A gas detector, bypassed for maintenance.
lines.delivery: Second vignette. Same weight.

tts_text.guide: A gas detector, bypassed for maintenance.
tts_text.elevenlabs: A gas detector, bypassed for maintenance.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A confined space entry, while the ventilation is down.
lines.delivery: Third vignette. Land it.

tts_text.guide: A confined space entry, while the ventilation is down.
tts_text.elevenlabs: A confined space entry, while the ventilation is down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Most work stays ordinary. The few changes that matter become decisions, made in time.
lines.delivery: Pulling back. Reassuring, measured.

tts_text.guide: Most work stays ordinary. The few changes that matter become decisions, made in time.
tts_text.elevenlabs: Most work stays ordinary. The few changes that matter become decisions, made in time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For everyone who carries the risk, the gap closes.
lines.delivery: Spoken to the risk carrier. Quiet conviction; let "the gap closes" land.

tts_text.guide: For everyone who carries the risk, the gap closes.
tts_text.elevenlabs: For everyone who carries the risk, the gap closes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora. Know the risk you carry, while the work happens.
lines.delivery: Calm, inevitable close. The name, a breath, the line.

tts_text.guide: Priora. Know the risk you carry, while the work happens.
tts_text.elevenlabs: Pree-OR-uh. Know the risk you carry, while the work happens.
